title: Because the chair wobbles, Dad!
scene: 他不坐椅子坐地上，并催爸爸修。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Why are you sitting on the floor, little tiger?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Let me see... You're right, one leg is loose.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So I moved to the floor. The floor never wobbles!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Should we fix the chair together?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes! Because a strong chair is better than the floor!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then bring me the big screwdriver from the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Coming, Dad! Screwdriver is on the way!
